items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: Ruth Lowe and Morgan were there

ctx.x: I played piano with Ruth Lowe the other day. You know the joke, can you play piano? I don't know, I never tried. I was sitting down there, I know three chords on the piano, and Ruth Lowe and Morgan were there, and there was a photographer there, so I started playing away on the piano. And I played the, you know, in C, I played C, G, and F, you know, C, F, and G, you know, in the right order sometimes, and sometimes in time, it was fun.
It doesn't fix me, you know. I think...
